env GOPROXY=off

! go tool compile -p p -o $WORK/p.o a.go b.lgo
stdout '\[correctness::mixed_package\] cannot mix \.go files \(a\.go\) and \.lgo files \(b\.lgo\) in one package'

! go tool compile -p p -o $WORK/s.o z.go a.go c.lgo b.⚡ e.⚡️
stdout '\[correctness::mixed_package\] cannot mix \.go files \(a\.go, z\.go\) and \.lgo files \(b\.⚡, c\.lgo, e\.⚡️\) in one package'

go tool compile -p p -o $WORK/q.o c.lgo d.lgo

go tool compile -p p -o $WORK/r.o e.lgo _cgo_gotypes.go x.cgo1.go

-- a.go --
package p

func A() int { return 1 }

-- b.lgo --
package p

func B() int { return 2 }

-- c.lgo --
package p

func C() int { return 3 }

-- d.lgo --
package p

func D() int { return 4 }

-- e.lgo --
package p

func E() int { return 5 }

-- z.go --
package p

func Z() int { return 26 }

-- b.⚡ --
package p

func Bz() int { return 7 }

-- e.⚡️ --
package p

func Ez() int { return 8 }

-- x.cgo1.go --
package p

func X() int { return 9 }

-- _cgo_gotypes.go --
package p

func CgoTypes() int { return 6 }
